given_when_then.given: A payment is processed between a customer and a store partner
given_when_then.when: The system generates a financial transaction record
given_when_then.then: The record must include item costs, delivery fees, taxes, platform commissions, and net settlement amounts.

given_when_then.given: A delivery proof is missing for a completed order
given_when_then.when: The system attempts to archive the financial transaction record
given_when_then.then: The system must flag the record as incomplete and prevent final settlement until delivery proof is provided.

success_criteria: The Financial Transaction Record includes item costs, delivery fees, taxes, platform commissions, and net settlement amounts.
The system flags the Financial Transaction Record as incomplete if delivery proof is missing.
The system prevents final settlement until delivery proof is provided.
Any deviation from the standard process is recorded with the nature of the issue and the current resolution status.
The system archives contractual details including commission rates and payout schedules alongside the Financial Transaction Record.
The system links a financial transaction record to verifiable evidence of delivery before finalizing the settlement status.
